findings.label: My focus ring is a box-shadow
findings.detail: focus is shown with a box-shadow normally and with nothing at all in forced-colors mode. box-shadow does not exist in this mode; use `outline` with a non-zero width, which is preserved, and keep `outline-offset` for the gap.

findings.label: Selected
findings.detail: <button> is distinguished from its siblings by background colour alone (rgb(29, 78, 216) against ['rgb(238, 238, 238)']), and in forced-colors every background becomes one system colour, so the distinction disappears. Whatever this colour meant -- selected, succeeded, current -- needs a second cue: a border, an icon, text, or a position (VIS-004, SC 1.4.1).

findings.label: This panel is delimited by its backgroun
findings.detail: <div> is separated from its surroundings by background colour alone (rgb(238, 242, 255) on rgb(255, 255, 255)), and in forced-colors both become the same system colour, so the boundary disappears. Add a border -- 1px is enough, and border-color IS forced, so it survives.
